$comment: WOOFi WooPPV2.swap, copied from the verified WooPPV2 on Arbitrum, 0xEd9e3f98bBed560e66B89AaC922E29D4596A9642 (solc 0.8.14). The Base deployment's implementation is not verified on any explorer; its dispatch table carries the same selector, 0x7dc20382. query(fromToken, toToken, fromAmount) is the same contract's quote, selector 0xf58a435f on Base too: it reverts when the oracle, the notional cap, the gamma bound or the output token's reserve refuses the trade (its tryQuery skips the reserve check and prices past it, so it is not used).
